scripts.precommit: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.gate:full: bun run check && bun run format:check && knip
scripts.dev: bun run build && wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.plan: bun run build && ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-werewolf ALCHEMY_PROFILE=werewolf alchemy plan
scripts.deploy: bun run check && bun run build && ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-werewolf ALCHEMY_PROFILE=werewolf alchemy deploy --yes
scripts.cloudflare-login: ALCHEMY_HOME=$HOME/.alchemy-werewolf ALCHEMY_PROFILE=werewolf alchemy profile edit --profile werewolf --add Cloudflare
